messages:
jordan_csm: Quick ask from OnboardCorp renewals: they want a concise SLO summary for the quarter and a clear breakdown of the credit calculation for last week's latency event. deadline = Wed EOD.

yasmin_ops: Confirming prod (hosted, us-west)?

jordan_csm: yes, prod us-west. include uptime %, p50/p95, incident window, and a short RCA.

yasmin_ops: We'll export the dashboard PNGs + CSVs. For the queries we used internally: p95 PromQL = ``histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))``. uptime calc = ``sum(up == 1) / count(up) * 100`` over the quarter window.

oliver_se: On the technical note: the anomaly aligns with a cache clear during a model rollout. KV cache cold-starts spiked backend latency for a short period. I can draft the RCA sentence and mitigation actions (staggered warms + deploy ramp).

paul_oncall: slo-bot recorded a breach. incident window per alerts: 2026-03-14T18:05:00Z - 2026-03-14T18:24:00Z. duration ~19m. I'll attach the deploy log snippet and the Grafana exports to ticket CS-8002.

jordan_csm: for credits, legal asks for explicit formula + example. we use: Credit = (incident_minutes / total_minutes_in_month) * monthly_fee. please include a worked example row in the appendix.

yasmin_ops: noted. we'll include the example: "Duration (min): 19 -> Credit = (19/43200)*monthly_fee" and explain rounding/truncation policy.

oliver_se: also recommend including an appendix with aggregated traces only; raw traces can be shared on request.

slo-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach for OnboardCorp (prod us-west). window 2026-03-14T18:05:00Z - 2026-03-14T18:24:00Z. ticket CS-8002 created. :rotating_light:

paul_oncall: all artifacts uploaded to /shared/CS/OnboardCorp/slo_bundle_2470012345/.

jordan_csm: i'll compile the one-pager + appendix and circulate Mon morning for review, then send to customer Wed EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
